plugins.name: cockpit
plugins.description: Band above the composer: quick replies, live standing, decision cards, waiting-on-you items, rule capture

plugins.name: stall-watch
plugins.description: Auto-retry transient API failures, usage-limit countdown, opt-in resume after a rate-limit reset

plugins.name: wrap
plugins.description: /wrap close-out checklist: tree, push, PR, CI on head, base freshness, merged, worktrees, background tasks

plugins.name: model-pin
plugins.description: Per-project model pin with a drift badge and a safe re-apply

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Holds your own prompt when it carries a credential shape; redact and reference instead

plugins.name: mem-gauge
plugins.description: RAM gauge under the composer and a /mem pane: per-session memory, agents, models, top processes, optimization advice

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: /handoff: a handoff note written from this session with secret shapes redacted, the conversation cleared, the next prompt pre-filled; what mem-gauge's Hand off button and the cockpit chip run

plugins.name: merge-lane
plugins.description: One merge lane per repo: priority queue, /lane commands, Bash merge gate, auto-release on merge, wake the next session

plugins.name: usage-gauge
plugins.description: (superseded by rd-ledger) Live cost and context chip in the prompt footer and a /spend pane: cost, context breakdown, rate limits, per-model tokens and cache hit, subagent share, code changes

plugins.name: rd-ledger
plugins.description: Contemporaneous R&D time and AI-usage ledger: engagement hours by business component, list-price usage estimates, a weekly review with buttons, a CPA export, an optional bridge to rd-tracker; metadata only, nothing leaves the Mac
